name: Repository Intelligence (deterministic typed-record producer)
purpose: The Collective Agent's repository-intelligence PRODUCER (D-0080 Wave 2, arch position 38). A stdlib-only Python worker (repo_intel.py) parses the Life Orchestrator repo BY SOURCE TYPE and emits TYPED record-envelope artifacts conforming to core-docs/MEMORY_CONTRACT.md section 1 (the record + provenance envelope v0.1), so the catalog (#36 artifact.search 0.2) can ingest them as FIRST-CLASS records, NOT chunks. op 'index' walks ALLOWLISTED roots (default modules/ + core-docs/) with TESTED privacy exclusions (.git/runtime/artifacts/venvs/__pycache__/model files/DBs/binaries/media), content-hashes a deterministic inventory, surfaces parser failures (never silently omits), runs DETERMINISTIC type-aware parsers (Markdown ATX heading/section hierarchy with fence-aware breadcrumbs; PowerShell .ps1/.psm1 function+class defs and Import-Module/using/dot-source imports via regex; Python .py def/class symbols and imports via the stdlib ast; skill.json manifests; JSON/config top-level structure), derives repository-intelligence RELATIONSHIPS (file->symbol defines edges, imports/dependency edges, file->module, test<->module, schema producer/consumer) as first-class 'relationship' records plus parent_edges/child_edges on structural records, builds DETERMINISTIC structural summaries (per-file outline, per-folder index, Markdown sections -- NO LLM), stamps every record with full provenance + parser/extractor FINGERPRINTS + schema_version, and VALIDATES every emitted record against MEMORY_CONTRACT s1 (required fields, content-derived id integrity, span-or-derivation_refs, edge-endpoint integrity). record_kinds emitted: symbol | entity | relationship | skill | summary. op 'validate' re-checks an existing records artifact against s1. Determinism: all ids are content+path derived; 'created_by_ingest_run' is a DETERMINISTIC content-derived id (never wall-clock); canonical artifacts (records.jsonl, records.json, ingest_records.json, index_manifest.json, inventory.json) use repo-relative paths + byte spans and contain NO absolute paths/timestamps/random ids -> identical corpus content yields byte-identical artifacts across runs AND machines. CPU-only, no model, no network -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance. This module EMITS artifacts only; it does NOT write the catalog DB (#36 owns storage). Non-goals (NOT built): AST call-graph / full reference resolution, LLM summaries, embeddings, episode/failure schema (#39), git-history parsing, the context compiler, any UI.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op index|validate (default index); -Root <dir> (index; a single root) OR -Roots <dir[,dir...]> (index; multiple roots); -Namespace <label> (logical corpus identity, slugged); -SourceLabel <label> (alias for namespace); -FileBudget <int> (0 = no cap; a hit is surfaced); -ExcludeDirs <name[,...]>; -ExcludeGlobs <glob[,...]>; -IncludeGlobs <glob[,...]>; -RecordsPath <records.jsonl|records.json> (validate); -PythonPath <python>; -WorkerPath <repo_intel.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json {op, root, roots[], namespace, source_label, file_budget, exclude_dirs[], exclude_globs[], include_globs[], records_path, python_path, worker_path}>' (named params override matching keys). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: index: a single directory root to walk (allowlisted).

inputs.name: roots
inputs.description: index: multiple directory roots (e.g. modules/ + core-docs/); rel paths are prefixed by each root's basename.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: index: a stable logical corpus identity (slugged); the machine-independent isolation scope carried on every record.

inputs.name: file_budget
inputs.description: index: per-root file budget (0 = no cap); a hit is surfaced as file_budget_hit + a warning.

inputs.name: exclude_dirs
inputs.description: index: directory segment names to exclude (default: .git, runtime, artifacts, __pycache__, node_modules, venvs, bin, obj, _to_delete, ...).

inputs.name: exclude_globs
inputs.description: index: filename globs to exclude (default: *.db, model files, binaries, media, archives, *.lock).

inputs.name: include_globs
inputs.description: index: optional filename globs; when present, only matching files are included.

inputs.name: records_path
inputs.description: validate: path to a records.jsonl or records.json (or an ingest_records.json) to re-validate against s1.

outputs.description: envelope.result = { op, namespace, total_records, record_counts_by_kind{symbol,entity,relationship,skill,summary}, record_kinds[], records_digest (sha256 over sorted per-record lines; machine-independent), file_count, excluded_count, file_budget_hit, parse_failure_count, parse_failures[{rel,reason,detail}], validation{ok,checked,error_count,errors[]}, edge_summary{total,resolved_internal,external}, ingest_run_id, records_path, runtime_ms, worker }. Artifacts (envelope.artifacts[], each path/kind/bytes/sha256): records.jsonl (one canonical s1 record per line -- THE ingest payload, deterministic order), records.json (canonical array), ingest_records.json (the #36 0.2 ingest_records drop-in: {schema,namespace,created_by_ingest_run,record_count,records[]}), index_manifest.json (counts + records_digest + fingerprints + validation), inventory.json (path/source_type/size/content_hash per file), parse_failures.json, summary.md. validate: result.validation + edge_summary only.
